sia-r1.name: Documents have a <title> element
sia-r1.description: This rule checks that documents have a <title> element that isn't empty or consists solely of whitespace.

sia-r2.name: Images have an accessible name
sia-r2.description: This rule checks that images have an accessible name.

sia-r4.name: <html> document elements have a lang attribute
sia-r4.description: This rule checks that document elements have a lang attribute.

sia-r5.name: <html> document elements have a valid lang attribute
sia-r5.description: This rule checks that document elements have a lang attribute that is valid.

sia-r7.name: lang attributes within the <body> element have a valid value
sia-r7.description: This rule checks that lang attributes specified on elements within the <body> element have a valid value.

sia-r8.name: Form fields have an accessible name
sia-r8.description: This rule checks that form fields have an accessible name.

sia-r9.name: Refreshes implemented using the <meta> element have no delay
sia-r9.description: This rule checks that refreshes and redirects implemented using the <meta> element are not delayed.

sia-r11.name: Links have an accessible name
sia-r11.description: This rule checks that elements with a role of link, have an accessible name.

sia-r12.name: Buttons have an accessible name
sia-r12.description: This rule checks that buttons, such as <button> elements and <input> elements with a type=button, type=reset, or type=submit attribute, have an accessible name.

sia-r14.name: Visible labels are included in accessible names
sia-r14.description: This rule checks that widgets that can be labeled through their content also have their visible label included in their accessible name.

sia-r15.name: <iframe> elements with identical accessible names serve an equivalent purpose
sia-r15.description: This rule checks that <iframe> elements with identical accessible names serve the same or an equivalent purpose.

sia-r16.name: Elements with a role have required states and properties
sia-r16.description: This rule checks that elements that have a role also specify all required states and properties for that role.

sia-r17.name: Elements with aria-hidden="true" are not focusable
sia-r17.description: This rule checks that elements that have been excluded from the accessibility tree using the aria-hidden attribute with a value of true are not, nor have descendants that are, focusable.

sia-r18.name: aria-* states and properties are allowed
sia-r18.description: This rule checks that ARIA states and properties are allowed by the element on which they are specified.

sia-r19.name: aria-* states and properties have a valid value
sia-r19.description: This rule checks that ARIA states and properties have a valid value.

sia-r20.name: aria-* attributes have a valid name
sia-r20.description: This rule checks that aria-* attributes have a valid name.

sia-r21.name: role attributes have only valid values
sia-r21.description: This rule checks that each role attribute has only valid tokens.

sia-r27.name: <video> element auditory content has accessible alternative
sia-r27.description: This rule checks that <video> elements have an alternative for information conveyed through audio.

sia-r28.name: <input type="image"> elements have an accessible name
sia-r28.description: This rule checks that image buttons have an accessible name.

sia-r30.name: <audio> element content has text alternative
sia-r30.description: This rule checks if audio only elements have a text alternative available.

sia-r35.name: <video> element visual-only content has accessible alternative
sia-r35.description: This rule checks that <video> elements without audio have an alternative available.

sia-r37.name: <video> element visual content has strict accessible alternative
sia-r37.description: This rule checks that <video> elements with audio have audio description.

sia-r38.name: <video> element visual content has accessible alternative
sia-r38.description: This rule checks that <video> elements with audio have an alternative for the video content as audio or as text.

sia-r39.name: Image filename is accessible name for image
sia-r39.description: This rule checks that image elements that use their source filename as their accessible name do so without loss of information to the user.

sia-r42.name: Elements with a role have required parent
sia-r42.description: This rule checks that an element with a semantic role exists inside its required context.

sia-r43.name: <svg> element with explicit role has non-empty accessible name
sia-r43.description: This rule checks that each SVG image element that is explicitly included in the accessibility tree has a non-empty accessible name.

sia-r44.name: Orientation of the page is not restricted using CSS transform property
sia-r44.description: This rule checks that page content is not restricted to either landscape or portrait orientation using the transform property.

sia-r45.name: Headers attribute specified on a cell refers to cells in the same table element
sia-r45.description: This rule checks that the headers attribute on a cell refer to other cells in the same <table> element.

sia-r46.name: All table header cells have assigned data cells
sia-r46.description: This rule checks that each table header has assigned data cells in a table element.

sia-r47.name: <meta name="viewport"> elements do not prevent zoom
sia-r47.description: This rule checks that the <meta> element retains the user agent ability to zoom.

sia-r50.name: <audio> or <video> avoids automatically playing audio
sia-r50.description: This rule checks that audio or video that plays automatically does not have audio that lasts for more than 3 seconds or has an audio control mechanism to stop or mute it.

sia-r53.name: Headings are structured
sia-r53.description: This rule checks that headings are properly nested.

sia-r55.name: Landmark regions with identical accessible names serve an equivalent purpose
sia-r55.description: This rule checks that landmark elements with identical accessible names serve the same or an equivalent purpose.

sia-r57.name: Perceivable text content is included in a landmark
sia-r57.description: This rule checks that all perceivable text content is included in a landmark region.

sia-r59.name: Documents have headings
sia-r59.description: This rule checks that documents have headings.

sia-r60.name: Groups have an accessible name
sia-r60.description: This rule checks that grouping elements for form controls have an accessible name.

sia-r61.name: Documents start with a level 1 heading
sia-r61.description: This rule checks that in each document the first heading has a level of 1.

sia-r63.name: <object> elements have an accessible name
sia-r63.description: This rule checks that <object> elements have an accessible name.

sia-r64.name: Heading has non-empty accessible name
sia-r64.description: This rule checks that each heading has a non-empty accessible name.

sia-r65.name: Element in sequential focus order has visible focus
sia-r65.description: This rule checks that each element in sequential focus order has some visible focus indication.

sia-r68.name: Elements with a role have required children
sia-r68.description: This rule checks that an element with a semantic role has at least one of its required owned elements.

sia-r69.name: Text has minimum contrast
sia-r69.description: This rule checks that the highest possible contrast of text nodes meets the minimal contrast requirement.

sia-r70.name: No obsolete or deprecated elements are used
sia-r70.description: This rule checks that HTML elements that have been deprecated are not used.

sia-r72.name: Paragraphs of text are not all uppercase
sia-r72.description: This rule checks that paragraphs of text are not all uppercase.

sia-r75.name: Font sizes are not too small
sia-r75.description: This rule checks that font sizes are larger than 9 pixels.

sia-r76.name: <th> elements are semantic headers
sia-r76.description: This rule checks that <th> elements are correctly marked up as headers for one or more columns or rows of a table.

sia-r77.name: Data cells are assigned at least one header cell
sia-r77.description: This rule checks that the data cells in a table are assigned to at least one header cell.

sia-r78.name: Headings of same level have text content between them
sia-r78.description: This rule checks that there is content between a heading and the next heading of the same or a lower level.

sia-r79.name: Preformatted text represents either code or a figure
sia-r79.description: This rule checks that preformatted text is used either to represent computer code or inside a figure.

sia-r81.name: Links with identical accessible names and context serve equivalent purpose
sia-r81.description: This rule checks that links with identical accessible names and context resolve to the same or equivalent resources.

sia-r84.name: Scrollable elements are keyboard accessible
sia-r84.description: This rule checks that scrollable elements can be scrolled by keyboard.

sia-r85.name: Paragraphs of text are not all italics
sia-r85.description: This rule checks that paragraphs of text are not all italics.

sia-r87.name: First focusable element is link to main content
sia-r87.description: This rule checks that the first focusable element is a link to the main content in the page.

sia-r90.name: Element with presentational children has no focusable content
sia-r90.description: This rule checks that elements with a role that makes its children presentational do not contain focusable elements.

sia-r91.name: !important letter spacing in style attribute is wide enough
sia-r91.description: This rule checks that the style attribute is not used to prevent adjusting letter-spacing by using !important, except if it's at least 0.12 times the font size.

sia-r92.name: !important word spacing in style attribute is wide enough
sia-r92.description: This rule checks that the style attribute is not used to prevent adjusting word-spacing by using !important, except if it's at least 0.16 times the font size.

sia-r93.name: !important line height in style attribute is wide enough
sia-r93.description: This rule checks that the style attribute is not used to prevent adjusting line-height by using !important, except if it's at least 1.5 times the font size.

sia-r94.name: menuitem has non-empty accessible name
sia-r94.description: This rule checks that each element with a menuitem role has a non-empty accessible name.

sia-r110.name: role attributes have at least one valid value
sia-r110.description: This rule checks that each role attribute has at least one valid token.
